title: Villa Coastalotta | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled along the tranquil stretches of 30A, this beautiful family home offers an idyllic retreat within walking distance to the beach and a nearby coastal dune lake, just three-tenths of a mile away. With biking and walking trails meandering through one of the quietest and most scenic parts of the area, guests are invited to enjoy the serene surroundings and soothing beach air. The residence is painted in calming hues of grey, white, and blue, creating a peaceful atmosphere that complements the coastal environment. Ample outdoor living spaces, including a front porch with rocking chairs and a screened back porch, enhance the home's charm, while a foosball table and outdoor cornhole game provide entertainment for all ages. Our family had a wonderful stay! Part of the reason I booked this house was because of how spacious it appeared in the photos, and it didn’t disappoint! We loved the beach access! We rented a golf cart, which made it super convenient, otherwise it would have been quite a walk with young children and beach gear, but we never had any problems finding parking for the golf cart. The house is located in a quiet and friendly neighborhood, and has some great walking trails close by. I actually loved that it wasn’t right on 30A, yet we were so close to our favorite spots. The beach chairs were another added bonus and the kitchen was well stocked. The only thing missing was some throw blankets to cozy up on the couch!
